name: 蛋糕灵魂 (随机颜色)

source: Quickly click on a player several
times while holding this item to
loreParagraphs.translation: 手持此物品时快速点击一名玩家数次,即可将其灵魂捕获其中!

source: Capturing a soul will soulbind this item.
loreParagraphs.translation: 捕获灵魂后,此物品将灵魂绑定.
